query:
SELECT mc.cardNumber, mc.characterName, 
  CASE 
    WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%cbh_%' THEN 'CARD_PHOTO'
    WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%comicbook%' THEN 'CARD_PHOTO'
    WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NULL THEN 'NO_IMAGE'
    ELSE 'AI_OR_OTHER'
  END as image_type,
  SUBSTRING(mc.imageUrl, 1, 100) as img_start,
  CASE WHEN mc.back_image_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_back
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
WHERE ms.slug = '2025-topps-comic-book-heroes' 
ORDER BY CAST(mc.cardNumber AS UNSIGNED)
LIMIT 10;
